stories.headline: Albertans vote to stay in Canada
stories.summary: Voters in Alberta have rejected pursuing a future referendum on separating from Canada. More than three-quarters supported the province remaining in Canada. The question was one of ten put to voters on 19 October 2026.

stories.headline: A pumpkin passes three thousand pounds for the first time
stories.summary: A grower in Rhode Island has produced the first pumpkin to surpass 3,000 pounds. Ron Wallace's gourd weighed 3,156 pounds, the largest fruit on record. The previous best, a pumpkin of nearly 2,857 pounds, had been set a week earlier by the British grower Ian Paton.

stories.headline: Japan launches a mission to scoop up a moon of Mars
stories.summary: Japan's space agency has launched the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center towards Phobos. The mission aims to collect at least 10 grams of surface material and return the samples to Earth in 2031. A small rover will be set down on Phobos in 2029 to scout a sampling site.
